title: Lesson index
description: Generated by tools/build_index.py. Don't edit by hand: rebuild it whenever lessons change.

folding.description: Human-readable description of the fold() used for searchKeys and lookup. Apply the same to the user's query.

entries.description: One entry per lesson, sorted by level then headword.

id.description: Stable id = file name without .json. Use it for links and progress tracking.

file.description: Path relative to the lessons folder, e.g. a1/mit.json.

forms.description: The headword first, then every form of this same word: article form, plural, conjugated and split verb forms ("rufe an"), past participles, comparatives, declined forms, and words taught inside this lesson (aliases). Display spelling, with umlauts.

related.description: Different but related words from the lesson's word family. Lower priority in search.

searchKeys.description: forms + related, folded, plus each noun form without its article.

lookup.description: Reverse map for exact matches: folded form -> lesson ids. A form can belong to more than one lesson.
